rows.abstract: "Coastal Environment Program Act of 1998". Defines "coastal environs" as land and sea-based natural resources, one linear kilometer from the highest tide point landward and 100 fathom isobath or 15 kilometers seaward where rehabilitation of mangroves, seagrass and coral reefs is needed, including the propagation of endangered species and the regulation of industries involved in its pollution under the supervision of the Department of Environment and Natural Resources.

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ORDAIN REFORMS IN THE ELECTRIC POWER SECTOR TO ENSURE THE TOTAL ELECTRIFICATION OF THE PHILIPPINES AND OPTIMAL PARTICIPATION OF THE PRIVATE SECTOR IN POWER GENERATION, TRANSMISSION AND DISTRIBUTION, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES (omnibus)
rows.abstract: "Omnibus Electric Power Industry Code of 1998" Seeks to reform the power sector by encouraging the participation of private corporations in power generation, transmission and distribution.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08457

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE NATIONAL LAND USE CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Amends and updates the existing classifiction of lienable public agricultural lands covering famrlands, friar lands, ancestral lands and private lands; allowing citizens who have tilled the land to file for a homestead, grant sale, lease, free patent and a chance to become its landowners.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 1998-07-28

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PENALIZE RACKETEERS AND CRIMINAL ENTERPRISES, PROHIBITING SUCH CRIMINAL ENTERPRISES AND RACKETEERS INFLUENCED AND CORRUPT ORGANIZATIONS FROM INFILTRATING, CONTROLLING OR OTHERWISE INFLUENCING PHILIPPINE COMMERCE (rico)
rows.abstract: "Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organization Act of 1998". Defines the scope of the terms "racketeer" and "organized crime syndicate"; imposes stiffer penalties on those engaged in criminal activities and organizations; and provides for the forfeiture of properties obtained from racketeering.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05216

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT LIBERALIZING THE RETAIL TRADE BUSINESS REPEALING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 1180, AS AMENDED, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Retail Trade Liberalization Law of 1998". Limits the opening up of the retail trade business to foreign investors only in large-scale operations, such as department stores, since small and medium retail enterprises are reserved only for Filipinos.
rows.status: Substituted by HB07602

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A NEW POPULATION POLICY, STRENGTHENING THE COMMISSION ON POPULATION, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Population Act of 1998". Establishes a new population policy which takes into account the recent developments in the field of population. Strengthens the Population Commission in order to achieve population levels that are conducive for the attainment of individual welfare, as well as the national goal of sustainable devleopment.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on POPULATION AND FAMILY RELATIONS since 1998-07-28

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO REVISE THE PHILIPPINE ENVIRONMENTAL CODE, DEFINING ITS SCOPE AND INTEGRATING ALL OTHER LAWS RELATIVE THERETO
rows.abstract: "Revised Philippine Environmental Code of 1998" Mandatess the Deaprtment of Environment and Natural Resources as the lead agency responsible for the rational and sustainable use and protection of the environment based on thresholds of health and consistent with current international norms.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10651

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE CONSERVATION AND PROTECTION OF WILDLIFE RESOURCES AND THEIR HABITATS, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Wildlife Resources Conservation and Protection Act". Seeks to protect and conserve wildlife species in the Philippines and to enahce their biological diversity through the regulation of the collection and trade of the wildlife.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10622

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT CONTROLLING THE DISCHARGE OF POLLUTANTS INTO OUR GULFS, BAYS, RIVERS, CREEKS, ESTEROS, DRAINAGE CHANNELS AND OTHER SIMILAR WATERWAYS, DECLARING CERTAIN ACTS UNLAWFUL, PRESCRIBING PENALTIES THERETO, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Water Pollution Control Act of 1998".  Seeks to protect, preserve and renew the quality of the bodies of water in the country, especially the gulfs, bays, lagoons, rivers, swamps, creeks and canals, and the improvement of drainage channels and other similar waterways.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ECOLOGY since 1998-07-28

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE REGULATION AND DISPOSAL OF BIO-CHEMICAL WASTES, DECLARING CERTAIN ACTS UNLAWFUL, PRESCRIBING PENALTIES THERETO, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Bio-Medical Waste Control Act of 1998". Declares it a State policy to protect and advance the right of the people to a balanced and healthful ecology and to promote the people's right to health.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 1998-07-28

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT STANDARDIZING CERTAIN GOVERNMENT CORPORATE POWERS AND FUNCTIONS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Government-Own ed or-Controlled Corporations Standardization Act of 1998". Grants fundamental and indispensable powers and functions to all the governing boards of the government-owne d or-controlled corporations in order to improve and ensure their active participation in the operation of these corporations. Specifies the working realtionships of these corporations with the government agencies concerned with regard to developmental planning, budgeting, civil service, accounting and auditing.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT ENTERPRISES AND PRIVATIZATION since 1998-07-28

rows.author: C065
rows.title_full: AN ACT REPEALING AUTOMATIC APPROPRIATIONS FOR DEBT SERVICE AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES, AMENDING THEREBY SECTION 26, CHAPTER 4, BOOK VI OF EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 292, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'ADMINISTRATIVE CODE OF 1987'
rows.abstract: Seeks to rationally and meaningfully allocate government resources by REPEALING automatic appropriation for debt service. Aims to have an effective and responsive determination of the true budgetary priorities of the nation.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 1998-07-28

rows.author: C065
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A MAGNA CARTA OF STUDENTS
rows.abstract: Provides for the following student's rights: quality education; organization and participation in policy-making; free expression and information; academic freedom; and due process in disciplinary proceedings. Enumerates the corresponding responsibilitie s of the students.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A087
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING NATURAL-BORN FILIPINO CITIZENS WHO HAVE LOST THEIR CITIZENSHIP CERTAIN RIGHTS AND PRIVILEGES ALLOWED TO FILIPINO CITIZENS
rows.abstract: "Natural-Born Filipino Citizens Act". Seeks to tap the resources of natural-born Filipino citizens who have gone abroad, embraced foreign citizenship, but are in a position to help in the development of our country.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1998-07-28

rows.author: C026
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING THE BOTIKA SA BARANGAY PROGRAM AND ESTABLISHING A BOTIKA SA BARANGAY IN EVERY BARANGAY NATIONWIDE FOR THE PURPOSE APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: "Botika sa Barangay Act of 1998"  Aims to make essential medicines and drugs available, affordable and accessible to the people in the barangay.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 1998-07-28

rows.author: C026
rows.title_full: AN ACT PENALIZING UNFAIR TRADE PRACTICES AND COMBINATIONS IN RESTRAINT OF TRADE, CREATING THE FAIR TRADE COMMISSION, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES (anti-trust)
rows.abstract: "Fair Trade Act of 1998". Seeks to promote healthy competition in trade, thereby resulting in increased output, faster growth and lower prices of goods.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 1998-07-28

rows.author: C026
rows.title_full: AN ACT ALLOWING THE USE OF ELECTION PROPAGANDA THROUGH MASS MEDIA AND THE POSTING OF CAMPAIGN MATERIALS DURING ELECTIONS UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTIONS EIGHTY-FIVE AND EIGHTY-SIX OF BATAS PAMBANSA BILANG 881 AND SECTIONSTEN AND ELEVEN OF REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED SIX THOUSAND SIX HUNDRED FORTY-SIX
rows.abstract: Seeks to LIFT the ban on the use of the media for electoral campaign purposes.
rows.status: Substituted by HB09000

principal_referral.committee: AD HOC COMMITTEE ON AGRICULTURE SERVICES CONVERGENCE INITIATIVE

rows.author: C026
rows.title_full: AN ACT BANNING CIGARETTES/CIGA R SMOKING IN CERTAIN PUBLIC PLACES AND IMPOSING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATION THEREOF
rows.abstract: "Anti-Smoking Act of 1998". PROHIBITS smoking of cigarettes, pipes  and cigars in hospitals, medical clinics, schools, public conveyances , enclosed or confined public areas, airconditioned rooms or buildings such as offices, hotels, shoppings malls, movie houses, recreational places and restaurants, except in designated smoking areas. Penalizes violation of this Act.
rows.status: Substituted by HB06211

rows.author: C026
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING UNLAWFUL CERTAIN PRIVATE ARMED GROUPS AND PROVIDING PENALTIES THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Declares the existence of private armed groups as inimical to the public interest, and which shall be prohibited.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SECURITY since 1998-07-28

rows.author: C026
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING ARTICLE 202 OF THE REVISED PENAL CODE, SO AS TO INCLUDE MALES IN THE DEFINITION OF PROSTITUTION
rows.abstract: States  that under Article 202 of the Revised Penal Code, only WOMEN who habitually INDULGE in sexual intercourse or lascivious conduct are deemed PROSTITUTES. However, MALES are also capable of engaging in prostitution, thus it proposes to redefineprostitute as "[women] persons who, for money or profit, habitually indulge in sexual intercourse or lascivious conduct."
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 1998-07-28

rows.author: C026
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO FOSTER LONG-TERM SOURCES OF DOMESTIC FINANCING BY PROVIDING INCENTIVES TO INDIVIDUALS TO INCREASE THEIR LONG- TERM SAVINGS
rows.abstract: "Long-Term Savings Act" Seeks to enhance personal and institutional savings to generate various sources of long-term funds to develop the capital markets.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BANKS AND FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES since 1998-07-28

rows.manual_status: Approved by the House and transmitted to the Senate on 1999-08-24
rows.author: C026
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 1999-08-23 and transmitted to the Senate on 1999-08-24
rows.title_full: AN ACT PENALIZING THE EMPLOYMENT OF CHILDREN IN ANY PUBLIC OR PRIVATE UNDERTAKING OR OCCUPATION WHICH IS CONSIDERED HAZARDOUS TO HIS/HER LIFE, SAFETY, HEALTH AND MORALS, OR WHICH UNDULY INTERFERES WITH HIS/HER NORMAL DEVELOPMENT, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Defines the term "child" for the purpose of this measure as any person below eighteen (18) years of age, or those over such age, but unable to fully take care of themselves and protect themselves from abuse, neglect, cruelty, exploitation or discrimination becuase of a physical or mental disability or condition. Identifies the various occupations considered hazardous to children.
rows.status: Substituted by HB06785

rows.author: C026
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A SYSTEM OF ABSENTEE VOTING FOR QUALIFIED FILIPINOS ABROAD, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: "Absentee Voting Act of 1998". Recommends that proper access to the right to vote by qualified Filipinos abroad be institutionaliz ed. Defines "absentee voting" as the process by which qualified Filipinos abroad who are not in their voting residenceon election day, may vote in the Philippine elections.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10720

rows.author: C026
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING ALL DEPARTMENTS AND AGENCIES OF GOVERNMENT TO ESTABLISH ACCESS TO THE INTERNET, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Compulsory Government Internet Access Act". Requires all departments and agencies of government to establish, install or arrange for a system that will provide and ensure access to the Internet and its facilities.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY since 1998-07-28

rows.author: C026
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A COMPREHENSIVE JUVENILE JUSTICE SYSTEM,  AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Applies to all youth offenders who are nine years, but below eighteen years of age at the time of commission of offense. Recognizes the need for special handling of youth offenders who are "just misguided children rather than die hard criminals."
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1998-07-28

rows.author: C026
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING PROTECTION TO JOURNALISTS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Journalists' Protection Act of 1998". Provides journalists with a comprehensive benefits package at par with the current benefits enjoyed by other workers.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC INFORMATION since 1998-07-28

rows.author: C026
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO STRENGTHEN DEVELOPING AND FINANCIALLY DISTRESSED HIGHER EDUCATION INSTITUTIONS THROUGH THE EXTENSION OF SPECIAL PROGRAMS AND EMERGENCY ASSISTANCE, PROVIDING FOR MECHANISMS OF IMPLEMENTATION, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Developing Institutions and Emergency Assistance Act of 1998". Substantiates the State policy to encourage higher education institutions to gear their programs to the country's development plans, foster the development of learning and development and develop effective and resposible leadership.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 1998-07-28

rows.author: C026
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO REVISE THE PHILIPPINE ENVIRONMENTAL CODE, DEFINING ITS SCOPE AND INTEGRATING ALL OTHER LAWS RELATIVE THERETO
rows.abstract: "Revised Philippine Environmental Code of 1998". Seeks to generate and protect the rights of all citizens to a balanced and healthful environment.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10651

rows.author: A017
rows.title_full: AN ACT TRANSLATING ALL LAWS INTO THE NATIONAL LANGUAGE
rows.abstract: "Filipinization of Laws Act of 1998". Aims to provide "equal protection of the laws" to all Filipino citizens, which  can be achieved if "those expected to follow the laws understand what they have to oby and why they have to obey."
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 1998-07-28

rows.manual_status: Approved by the House and transmitted to the Senate on 2000-12-21
rows.author: A017
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2000-12-20, transmitted to on 2000-12-21 and received by the Senate on 2000
rows.title_full: AN ACT REORGANIZING THE MOVIE AND TELEVISION REVIEW CLASSIFICATION BOARD, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Proposes amendments such as on (1) the composition of the MTRCB; (2) term of office of the Board; (3) representation of the different sectors of society in the Board; (4) enhancement of the compensation package of officers and rank-and-file employees.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10711

rows.author: A017
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE AUTOMATIC RETENTION BY THE BARANGAY OF ITS SHARE OF FIFTY PERCENT (50%) IN THE COMMUNITY TAX COLLECTED BY SAID BARANGAY, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 164 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENTCODE OF 1991
rows.abstract: Allows the barangay concerned to AUTOMATICALLY RETIAN the fifty percent (50%) share of the barangay in the community tax collected, and remit the share of the city  or municipality concerned within TEN (10) days after the end of each month.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A017
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO FURTHER STRENGTHEN CONSUMER PROTECTION BY AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE CERTAIN PROVISIONS OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7394, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE CONSUMER ACT OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Seeks to place the National Consumer Affairs Council (NCAC) under the Office of the President, provide the same with additional powers, and INCLUDE the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas as one of the implementing agencies of this Act.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 1998-07-28

rows.author: B015
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR UNIFORM RETIREMENT BENEFITS FOR ALL GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS AND EMPLOYEES, PRESCRIBING PROCEDURES IN THE PROMPT PAYMENT THEREOF AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Fixes the AGE for compulsory retirement at SIXTY YEARS, and the SERVICE requirement for optional retirement  at TWENTY YEARS. Contains other special features.
rows.status: Substituted by HB12835
